patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Sellfy and Squarespace share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Sellfy only if your buying job matches “Ecommerce platform for digital downloads and subscriptions — affiliate partner in ecommerc” rather than Squarespace's shape. Choose Squarespace only if your buying job matches “Design-led website builder with commerce — Basic $16, Core $23, Plus $39, Advanced $99/mo ” rather than Sellfy's shape. Workflow advantage: Sellfy leans digital-business-marketplace; Squarespace leans checkout-conversion, website-builder-commerce. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Sellfy and Squarespace share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Sellfy is Ecommerce platform for digital downloads and subscriptions — affiliate partner in ecommerce.; Squarespace is Design-led website builder with commerce — Basic $16, Core $23, Plus $39, Advanced $99/mo annual (US 2026 tiles); platform transaction fees .
- Company-size focus: Sellfy (micro, small-business) vs Squarespace (solo, micro, small-business).
- Workflow coverage skew: Sellfy-leaning digital-business-marketplace vs Squarespace-leaning checkout-conversion, website-builder-commerce.
- Researched limits: Sellfy — none listed; Squarespace — Platform transaction fees on lower tiers can exceed the subscription savings at volume.

Limitations — Sellfy: —; Squarespace: Platform transaction fees on lower tiers can exceed the subscription savings at volume; Catalog and B2B depth trail commerce-first platforms.

Poor-fit cases: Squarespace is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Platform transaction fees on lower tiers can exceed the subscription savings at volume · Avoid Sellfy if you actually need Squarespace's motion (Design-led website builder with commerce — Basic $16, Core $23, Plus $39, Advanc) · Avoid Squarespace if you actually need Sellfy's motion (Ecommerce platform for digital downloads and subscriptions — affiliate partner i)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
